target_customer: Enterprise teams that want agents and humans to run workflows together without engineering
problem: Agents fail in enterprises because they lack shared context across systems and teams do not know which tasks to automate.
business_model: Enterprise B2B SaaS workflow orchestration platform

founders.name: Tim Cherkasov
founders.background_notes: YC page also lists data science roles at hedge funds and scaleups. Education not on YC page.

founders.name: Artur Romanov
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as a multi-time founder; led backends at logistics and finance companies.

competitors.name: Workato
competitors.what: Launched Workato One in March 2025 as an orchestration platform for enterprise AI agents

competitors.name: Tines
competitors.what: Added AI agents to workflow automation, with human-in-the-loop options

technical_complexity.rationale: Company-wide context indexing, a visual builder and routing between agents and humans is standard engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Incumbent workflow vendors are adding agents; context index and embedded workflows could create switching costs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: TechCrunch in February 2026 notes Atlassian's Jira and Anthropic enterprise agent plug-ins may compete; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: Enterprises struggled to adopt agents in 2025 and incumbents launched orchestration products, showing demand. Company claims 30+ companies using it at launch.

identity.voice_and_tone: Founder positions Trace as the manager that decides where AI interns go.

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch and founder posts about pivot hell before Trace; TechCrunch coverage.

brand_strength.rationale: Short name but heavily shared with unrelated companies named Trace, which dilutes search.

outcome_analysis: Trace raised a $3M seed in February 2026 after the Summer 2025 batch and says over 30 companies use it. A team of three with fintech and logistics engineering backgrounds is early. Agent platforms from Workato, Tines and Atlassian make this a crowded field.
notes: Round confirmed by TechCrunch (Feb 26, 2026) and a second outlet (aichief); one source names Xeno Ventures instead of Zeno. Company site fetch was blocked by a rate-limited safety check. Education for founders not on YC page; one aggregator profile gives a UCL MSc for the CEO but it was not opened and is not recorded. YesPress lists a San Francisco HQ while TechCrunch says London. n8n was dropped from the competitor list because no dated source was found. Downgraded to depth 1 by orchestrator: the researcher reported skipping the separate outcome search and the funding cross-check, and removed undated competitors to clear warnings.
